item.title: Avalanche kills 2 near Long Pass, Washington
item.description: At least 2 people were killed by an avalanche near Long Pass in Washington’s Cascade Mountains on January 9, 2026, while two others were safely rescued.

item.title: Strong and shallow M6.2 earthquake hits Kuril Islands, Russia
item.description: A strong and shallow earthquake registered by the USGS as M6.2 struck the Kuril Islands region, Russia, at 07:34 UTC on January 13, 2026. The agency is reporting a depth of 35.8 km (22.2 miles).

item.title: Deadly avalanches strike the French Alps, leaving six dead in Savoie resorts
item.description: At least six people have been killed in separate avalanche incidents across the French Alps, with the latest fatalities being reported on January 11, 2026.

item.title: Landslide kills at least 13, leaves 30 missing in Burutsi village, North Kivu, DR Congo
item.description: A landslide killed at least 13 people and left 30 more missing in the Burutsi village, Kashebere area of Walikale Territory, DR Congo, on January 13, 2026.

item.title: F2 tornado damages hundreds of homes in São José dos Pinhais, Brazil
item.description: An F2 tornado struck Guatupê, São José dos Pinhais, in Brazil on January 10, 2026, damaging hundreds of homes and leaving 2 people with minor injuries.
